name: The Singapore EDITION
positioning: Ian Schrager-designed EDITION hotel in Singapore's upper Orchard Road shopping district, with a signature restaurant, several bars, a spa and a rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led city hotel with distinctive bars near Orchard Road
Guests who like a spa with thermal facilities and a 24-hour gym

facts.text: The Singapore EDITION is in the upper Orchard Road shopping district, a short walk from the Singapore Botanic Garden.
The rooms and suites have decor and detailing by Ian Schrager.
Guest room floors are white oak planks with warm white rugs, and the beds have hand-sewn damask throws.
Tanica serves modern Asian cuisine flavoured with regional herbs and spices, grilled over the Josper or char-fried in the wok.
Tanica is on level one past the Lobby Bar, and a spiral staircase leads down to the lower ground bars.
Punch Room is a bar done in Yves Klein blue, with oak-panelled walls and ceilings and a blue ceiling pendant by Parisian artist Eric Schmitt.
The Lobby Bar has sharp pink velvet walls and a rose-colored pool table of Calacutta marble.
The spa is on the second floor and has seven treatment rooms.
The spa's changing suites have thermal pools, an ice fountain, a sauna and steam rooms.
The gym is on the second floor, open 24 hours, with TechnoGym equipment.
The hotel has a rooftop pool.
